contract: A half-open probe lease can be settled only by the outcome for the exact epoch and probe sequence that acquired it. A late pre-open request may update its own metrics but cannot release or decide the half-open probe. At most one probe is admitted in that epoch.

evidenceRequirements.description: Establish any valid causal witness from the supplied code and context; exact driver numbers/order are not required. One evaluator-only witness: An old request starts in epoch0. Another failure opens epoch1; the cooldown admits probe(epoch1,seq3). The old success invokes settle while half-open. Without matching the lease, it closes the breaker and clears the probe while the real probe still runs, allowing another request. A matched lease preserves half-open occupancy until its owner settles.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: Current probe success closes; current probe failure reopens with fresh cooldown; old failure cannot reopen a later epoch; duplicate settlement cannot mutate a new probe.
The breaker completion contract: are pre-open completions barred from releasing half-open probes, or can any success deliberately close the breaker?

Under this contract: A half-open probe lease can be settled only by the outcome for the exact epoch and probe sequence that acquired it. A late pre-open request may update its own metrics but cannot release or decide the half-open probe. At most one probe is admitted in that epoch. the traced behavior is a defect. Alternative: If the configured recovery policy explicitly lets any observed success close the breaker, the old success and subsequent normal admission are allowed; this is a different recovery policy rather than a proven probe-lease violation.

forbiddenClaims: Production outage, real data exfiltration or universal safety without supplied evidence.
